entries.22e89b9c1d7bcf6e: This business develops, manufactures, sells and maintains process equipment for electronic device manufacturing, such as semiconductors and liquid crystal displays, and related peripheral equipment. The Semiconductor Equipment division handles coating equipment, developing equipment and equipment for advanced packaging, and its main product is the Wafer Support System compatible with various wafers. The Transfer Equipment division handles industrial robots that transfer wafers between semiconductor manufacturing processes and their units, the Cleaning Equipment division handles single-wafer cleaning equipment and batch immersion cleaning equipment, and the Coater division handles color filter manufacturing equipment for TFT color liquid crystal displays.
